rationale: Amendment B applies ASPICE change control to the protection profile. Land the shared substrate first: the E4 business-event record (US-014a — features/workTopic/baselineVersion, NG-23) that both E6 and E7 read. Then E2 onboarding: baseline (US-042, NG-22 — the load-bearing story; supersedes publishActivePolicy and reconciles flags F1/F4), multi-pass convergence (US-040, reconciles F2 on NG-6), clarifying questions (US-041). Then E6: previewRuleNarrowing becomes a real before/after over features (US-022a, resolves F3), the review cycle (US-043, Review-Vorschlag), and change-request → next baseline (US-044). Finally the shared-record read in E7 (US-025a) and the E5 terminology strings (US-036a, B6). Suffix 'a' marks a re-open of a built story.

F2 — amend NG-6 wording to 'one convergence run (multiple passes) per policy version'.
F3 — reimplement previewRuleNarrowing after-count over the stored structural features (drop measured:false).
F4 — AF-209 baselineProfile supersedes publishActivePolicy as the activation path (versioned, supersede-logged, prior readable).
